variables.title: Variables
variables.code:
var a int = 1
b := 2 // Short syntax
const c = 3
variables.notes: Go emphasizes explicit declaration and offers a short := syntax for inference.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.code:
var i int = 42
var f float64 = 3.14
var s string = "Go"
var b bool = true
type User struct { Name string }
data_types.notes: Statically typed, with a mix of basic types and structs instead of classes.

operators.title: Operators
operators.code:
x := 10 + 5
y := x * 2
isEqual := x == y
isValid := isEqual && true
operators.notes: Standard C-family operators, but lacks ternary operator.

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.notes: No parentheses needed around conditions. Supports an initialization statement.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: The only looping construct in Go is 'for', handling traditional loops and range iterations.

while_loop.title: While Loop
while_loop.notes: Go uses the 'for' keyword with a single condition to represent a while loop.

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Supports multiple return values and named return variables.

arrays.title: Arrays & Slices
arrays.notes: Slices are dynamic views over underlying fixed-size arrays.

maps.title: Maps
maps.code:
m := make(map[string]int)
m["key"] = 42
val, ok := m["key"] // Check if exists
delete(m, "key")
maps.notes: Built-in hash maps. Checking existence is idiomatic with the comma ok idiom.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.notes: Errors are just values implementing the error interface. Explicit checking is required.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: Go provides comments to document code behavior.

numbers.title: Numbers & Constants
numbers.notes: Go supports numeric literals for computation and indexing.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: Go provides boolean conditions for program control flow.

type_casting.title: Type Conversion
type_casting.notes: Go converts data between native format representations.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: Go represents textual data through string literals and character arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: Go formats and joins textual values for display and output.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Branching
pattern_matching.code:
case value of
    1: execute_one()
    default: execute_default()
pattern_matching.notes: Go branches execution based on value comparison and conditional expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Intervals
range.notes: Go defines intervals and index sequences for bounded processing.

iterators.title: Iteration & Loops
iterators.notes: Go iterates across collections and sequence elements.

oop_classes.title: Structures & Modules
oop_classes.notes: Go organizes data and behavior through structures or modular components.

lists.title: Collections & Arrays
lists.notes: Go stores sequence data in indexed lists or arrays.

tuples.title: Records & Pairs
tuples.notes: Go groups related fields into lightweight composite pairs or records.

sets.title: Sets & Uniqueness
sets.notes: Go tracks unique values without duplicate entries.

modules_import.title: Libraries & Modules
modules_import.notes: Go organizes external libraries and code units into modular namespaces.
